arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Worker in a low left-facing crouch, torso nearly horizontal, head at far screen-left looking down-left with one profile eye. Near arm reaches diagonally down-left from the head-side shoulder. Far arm folds backward over upper-right torso with elbow lifted and hand near right hip. Left supporting shin descends under hip; right leg bends back with foot farther right. One continuous back-folded arm, not two separate sleeves. No props. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
